sections.title: Market Pulse: US Stocks Rebound on Softening Oil Prices, Fed Rate Hike Digested

items.headline: Major US indices finished mostly higher today, rebounding from earlier session losses as lower oil prices eased inflationary concerns and softened Treasury yields.
items.summary: The market initially reacted to the Federal Reserve's first interest rate hike in three years, announced yesterday, a move signaling the Fed's concern about rising prices. However, investor sentiment improved throughout the day following news of progress in restoring Saudi oil capacity, which helped temper recent surges in wholesale energy inflation. This positive shift led to gains across broad market benchmarks.

items.headline: Fed Raises Interest Rates for the First Time Since 2023 Amid Inflation Concerns
items.summary: The Federal Reserve raised interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point yesterday, the first hike in three years, in an effort to combat persistent inflation driven by surging energy prices. The move signals the Fed's commitment to price stability, with expectations for further hikes later this year.

items.headline: US GDP Increased 1.5% in Q2 2026; Trade Deficit Widens in July
items.summary: The second estimate for real gross domestic product (GDP) in the second quarter of 2026 showed an increase of 1.5% annually, driven by consumer spending, exports, and investment. Separately, the U.S. goods and services trade deficit expanded in July 2026 to $88.6 billion as imports rose and exports declined.

items.headline: August 2026 Housing Data: Building Permits Fall, Pending Home Sales Edge Up
items.summary: US building permits saw a 2.7% month-over-month decrease in August 2026, falling below market expectations. Conversely, pending home sales in the US edged up by 0.3% in August, bouncing back from a decline in July, despite rising mortgage rates.

items.headline: Industrials Lead Market Gains, Energy Sector Lags Today
items.summary: In today's trading session, Industrials emerged as the best-performing sector with a gain of +0.81%, followed by Utilities (+0.32%) and Information Technology (+0.21%). On the other hand, the Energy sector lagged significantly, closing down -2.37%, with Financials (-1.38%) and Materials (-0.77%) also underperforming.

items.headline: Over 100 Companies Report Earnings Today
items.summary: Approximately 104 companies were scheduled to release their earnings reports today, September 17, 2026. Notable companies reporting included KNDI, UPXI, and VFS, among others. Investors are closely monitoring these reports for insights into corporate performance and future guidance.
